clauses.title: 1. LEASED PREMISES AND USE
clauses.text: 1. LEASED PREMISES AND USE. Landlord leases 4,000 square feet of commercial office space at 200 Harbor Boulevard, Suite 500, Seattle, WA for general software engineering use.

clauses.title: 2. BASE RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
clauses.text: 2. BASE RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $9,200.00 USD on the 1st of each month and deposit an initial security deposit of $18,400.00 USD.

clauses.title: 3. LEASE TERM AND RENEWAL NOTICE
clauses.text: 3. LEASE TERM AND RENEWAL NOTICE. Lease duration is thirty-six (36) months commencing January 1, 2027, with renewal option on ninety (90) days advance written notice.

clauses.title: 4. MAINTENANCE DIVISION OF RESPONSIBILITIES
clauses.text: 4. MAINTENANCE DIVISION OF RESPONSIBILITIES. Landlord maintains exterior roof, foundation, and elevators; Tenant maintains interior lighting and plumbing fixtures.
